about: Livorno: the houses by the road (tools/livorno/hise.py). att: a hex digit a building (bits: a neighbour against its wall at -x, +x, -z, +z of its own frame); wings: [building, [[x, z, length, width (its own frame), walls (base 3: -x, +x, -z, +z; 1 a neighbour, 2 a wing of its own), how far the roof may run on behind each wall], ...]]; roads: [class (0 asphalt, 1 paving, 2 gravel), width, [x, z, ...]]; osm: roof {building: 1 gabled, 2 hipped, 3 flat, 4 pyramidal}, levels {building: floors}, walk [left, right]: [from, to] m after the start line where the road has a sidewalk, walk2: the same with the built-up streets the map has none drawn on (a guess: houses along the road), pools [x, z, length, width, angle].
